articles.title: Identifican y sancionan a seis ultras de la Real Sociedad con armas blancas y bengalas cerca de Anoeta
articles.standfirst: Durante el operativo previo al partido de la Europa League ante el Olympique de Lyon
articles.summary: Durante el operativo previo al partido de la Europa League ante el Olympique de Lyon
articles.body: La Ertzaintza ha identificado y sancionado a seis ultras realistas durante el operativo previo al partido de fútbol de Europa League que enfrenta a la Real Sociedad con el Olympique de Lyon y ha localizado entre sus pertenencias bastones extensibles, armas blancas, bengalas y drogas. Según informó este jueves el Departamento vasco de Seguridad, la Policía vasca estableció a primera hora de la tarde de ayer, miércoles, un dispositivo preventivo de vigilancia en los alrededores del estadio de Anoeta para evitar posibles altercados entre las aficiones de la Real Sociedad y el Olympique de Lyon. En el operativo se detectó un grupo de unas 100 personas que se habría reunido en una zona cercana al estadio donostiarra, utilizada habitualmente como punto de reunión de la afición realista, que se encontraban en "actitud vigilante". Según se pudo comprobar, se trataba de "aficionados radicales que apoyan a la Real Sociedad, así como de otros grupos afines" de equipos como "el Celta de Vigo y el Deportivo Alavés", precisó Seguridad. En ese momento se desplegó un dispositivo de vigilancia y control ante la posibilidad de un enfrentamiento con aficionados radicales franceses del Olympique de Lyon. A lo largo de este despliegue, desarrollado durante la tarde noche de ayer, agentes de la Ertzaintza identificaron a una veintena de aficionados radicales de dichos grupos ultras en las inmediaciones del estadio. En estas identificaciones se detectaron diversos objetos y armas prohibidas como porras extensibles, botes de espray de defensa y armas blancas, bengalas y sustancias estupefacientes. Finalmente, seis aficionados radicales de la Real Sociedad fueron propuestos para ser sancionados por infracción de la Ley Orgánica de protección de seguridad ciudadana. Los expedientados, tienen entre 20 y 31 años y cuentan con antecedentes con la Ertzaintza. En concreto, uno de ellos, de 27 años ha sido sancionado previamente 13 veces por infracciones a la ley de protección de la seguridad ciudadana y le constan dos detenciones por atentado a agentes y robo con violencia.

articles.title: Raphinha: "¿La selección? Que los culés no estén preocupados"
articles.standfirst: El brasileño desveló durante su renovación que ha hablado con Ancelotti
articles.summary: El brasileño desveló durante su renovación que ha hablado con Ancelotti
articles.body: Raphinha firmó este jueves su renovación hasta 2030 acompañado de su mujer y de su hijo. El capitán del Barça se mostró orgullo por prolongar su vinculación con el club y reconoció que está sorprendido por los registros goleadores que está firmando, aunque considera que todavía tiene margen para mejorar. Su gran objetivo sigue siendo conquistar la Champions, sin renunciar por ello a ninguno de los títulos en juego. Además, aprovechó para mandar un mensaje de calma y tranquilidad a la grada ante el próximo parón de selecciones. Raphinha es consciente de la preocupación que generan sus problemas físicos cuando se marcha con Brasil y aseguró que ha hablado directamente con Ancelotti. "Sabe que tiene que repartir minutos. Para la selección también sería complicado una lesión. Hemos hablado, sabe que me estoy recuperando de la última dolencia. Estoy bien, pero no al cien por cien. Que los culés no estén preocupados porque me cuido mucho", explicó el extremo. En las últimas citas con su combinado, el culé siempre ha sufrido diferentes contratiempos físicos. En clave azulgrana, Raphinha tampoco escondió su sorpresa por los números que está consiguiendo durante el presente curso. Con 19 goles en 13 partidos, el brasileño atraviesa uno de los mejores momentos de su carrera. Sin embargo, lejos de conformarse con sus estadísticas actuales, el capitán considera que todavía puede ofrecer mucho más. "Me ha sorprendido el rendimiento, pero puedo llegar mucho más lejos. No me imaginaba llevar tantos goles a estas alturas. Busco siempre dar lo mejor. Siempre intento adaptarme muy rápido a todo. Sabía que podía marcar jugando de 9 porque, estando cerca de la portería, es más fácil", reconoció un Raphinha que no descartó la posibilidad de terminar su carrera en el Spotify Camp Nou, siempre que su condición física se lo permita. La renovación hasta 2030 también representa una declaración de intenciones. Raphinha quiere seguir siendo una pieza importante del proyecto azulgrana y contribuir a devolver al Barcelona a lo más alto del fútbol europeo. La Champions ocupa un lugar especial entre sus objetivos, aunque el brasileño dejó claro que no quiere centrar todas sus aspiraciones en una única competición. "Todos los futbolistas quieren ser reconocidos por los títulos. De momento, los números son positivos. Tengo una meta muy grande, al igual que los otros compañeros, y hacemos lo posible para ello. Pero no quiero solo ese título", afirmó. El internacional brasileño también aprovechó la comparecencia para recordar los momentos más complicados de su trayectoria como azulgrana. Sus primeros años en el club estuvieron marcados por las críticas y las dudas de una parte de la afición, que cuestionó su rendimiento y el acierto de su fichaje. Sin embargo, Raphinha aseguró que nunca dejó de confiar en sus posibilidades y que siempre mantuvo intacto su compromiso con el equipo. "Desde el primer día siempre he dado lo mejor, de todas las maneras posibles. Obviamente no tuve los resultados que la gente esperaba, pero siempre supe lo que podía hacer con esta camiseta. Siempre, en mi opinión, he hecho lo mismo: he dado mi vida, con intensidad, he marcado mucho... Un jugador que llega de un equipo sin la grandeza del Barça y mete 10 goles, lo hemos de considerar bien. Lo he hecho las dos temporadas que querían expulsarme del club. Luego ya tuve más confianza y tranquilidad para hacer mi trabajo. Si miras mis dos primeros años, no me imaginaba estar aquí, pero yo sabía dónde podía llegar y confiaba en mi trabajo, en mi calidad y en las ganas", recordó. Raphinha tuvo palabras de reconocimiento para Deco y Lamine Yamal. El capitán azulgrana se deshizo en elogios hacia el director deportivo, al que atribuyó un papel determinante en su crecimiento. En cuando a Lamine Yamal, destacó la enorme calidad del joven extremo y dejó claro la admiración mutua entre ambos. "Yo quiero siempre que él tenga los mejores números, conquiste todo en su carrera y, si le preguntas a él, te dirá lo mismo. Estaría muy contento que ganase 10 Balones de Oro, lo merece por lo que está haciendo y hará", aseguró. Por último, Raphinha también se refirió al próximo compromiso del Barcelona contra al Atlético de Madrid en el Metropolitano. El brasileño reconoció el respeto que merece el conjunto rojiblanco, pero dejó claro que el Barcelona dispone de argumentos suficientes para competir al máximo nivel y pelear por los tres puntos en una de las salidas más exigentes del calendario.

articles.title: Celta - Union Saint-Gilloise: a qué hora, canal y dónde ver en TV el partido de Europa League en directo hoy
articles.standfirst: Todos los detalles de la jornada de Europa League del 5 de noviembre
articles.summary: Todos los detalles de la jornada de Europa League del 5 de noviembre
articles.body: Balaídos vuelve a vestirse de gala para una noche europea en la que el Celta necesita sumar. El conjunto de Claudio Giráldez recibe a un Union Saint-Gilloise que todavía no conoce la derrota en esta edición de la Europa League y que se ha instalado entre los equipos mejor situados de la clasificación. Los celestes llegan al ecuador de la fase liga con la obligación de aprovechar el factor campo. Después de un inicio complicado, el triunfo conseguido en Glasgow ante el Celtic ha devuelto al equipo gallego a la pelea por la siguiente ronda. Enfrente estará un conjunto belga que ha demostrado ser un rival competitivo y que buscará prolongar su buena dinámica lejos de casa. El partido entre el Celta de Vigo y el Union Saint-Gilloise se juega hoy jueves 5 de noviembre a las 21:00 horas (horario peninsular español). El partido entre el Celta y el Union Saint-Gilloise, correspondiente a la cuarta jornada de la fase liga de la Europa League, se podrá ver por televisión en directo a través de Movistar Liga de Campeones y Movistar Liga de Campeones 3, disponibles en Movistar Plus+. También se podrá seguir a través de LaLiga TV Bar. El encuentro contará con la narración de Radio MARCA y los comentarios en directo de MARCA.com. El Celta llega al encuentro después de conseguir una importante victoria por 2-1 ante el Celtic de Glasgow en la tercera jornada de la Europa League. Javi Rodríguez fue el gran protagonista de aquel partido, con un doblete que permitió al conjunto gallego sumar sus primeros tres puntos en la competición. El equipo gallego comenzó la fase liga con dos derrotas, ante el Omonia y la Juventus, por lo que necesita seguir sumando para acercarse a los puestos de clasificación. En LaLiga, los celestes vienen de perder por 3-0 ante el Rayo Vallecano. El Union Saint-Gilloise visita Balaídos después de firmar un buen comienzo en la Europa League. El conjunto belga suma siete puntos de nueve posibles, con dos victorias y un empate, y todavía no conoce la derrota en la fase liga. Los visitantes ocupan la sexta posición de la clasificación y tratarán de mantener su lugar entre los ocho primeros, que dan acceso directo a los octavos de final. El Celta tendrá enfrente a un rival que ha demostrado solidez y que llega a Vigo con la confianza de su buen rendimiento europeo.

articles.title: Benzema arropa a Vinicius en sus horas bajas: “Nº1 siempre”
articles.standfirst: El delantero francés, que durante años ejerció de guía y socio del brasileño en el Madrid, le dedica un gesto de apoyo en su momento más delicado
articles.summary: El delantero francés, que durante años ejerció de guía y socio del brasileño en el Madrid, le dedica un gesto de apoyo en su momento más delicado
articles.body: Lejos del ruido que rodea estos días a Vinicius, Karim Benzema escogió tres palabras. Una foto de los dos juntos, de aquella época en la que compartían vestuario y área, y una leyenda breve: “Nº1 siempre”. El número uno, para siempre. El gesto, publicado en un momento espinoso para el brasileño, devuelve a la actualidad una de las sociedades más fértiles del Madrid reciente. Porque lo de Benzema y Vinicius fue, durante años, un matrimonio futbolístico de los que dejan huella. En la Liga 2021-22, la del título 35, los dos participaron en 60 de los 73 goles del equipo, cuatro de cada cinco. El francés firmaba los remates —26 dianas aquel curso, camino del Pichichi y, después, del Balón de Oro— y el brasileño ponía el desborde, los centros y la electricidad por la izquierda. Juntos conquistaron Ligas y la Decimocuarta Champions, aquella de las remontadas imposibles en las que la conexión entre ambos resultó decisiva. El vínculo trascendió el césped. Benzema ejerció de hermano mayor desde que Vinicius aterrizó en Madrid con 18 años, recién llegado de Brasil, en pleno proceso de pulir su talento. “Yo creo en Vinicius. Hablo mucho con él”, reconoció el francés en 2021, admitiendo que a veces “le hablo un poquito fuerte” porque sabía que el extremo podía dar más. Lo definió entonces con una frase que resume su fe en él: “Es un fenómeno cuando quiere”. El propio Vinicius devolvió el crédito y señaló a Benzema como quien más lo había ayudado, el que le enseñó a decidir mejor sobre el campo. Con el paso de las temporadas, el papel de maestro y alumno se transformó en una complicidad de tú a tú, hasta que la marcha del delantero a Arabia Saudí en 2023 separó los caminos. Hoy Benzema se encuentra sin equipo tras rescindir este verano su contrato, y desde esa distancia, con más tiempo para mirar atrás, ha querido recordarle a su viejo socio quién es.

articles.title: Compromise over St Ives bar and restaurant's harbourside benches
articles.summary: Councillors agree to let business have two benches instead of three.
articles.body:
A harbourside bar and restaurant has been told it can have two benches outside its premises instead of three.

Neighbouring businesses complained the benches outside Balcony Bar And Kitchen in St Ives, Cornwall, were causing "chaos" with people blocking entrances, affecting trade and leaving litter.

David Fox, the venue's owner, told Cornwall Council the tables outside his business were an asset and the area was regularly cleaned by staff.

The council's Street Trading and Pavement Licensing Committee agreed to renew a licence for two of the benches as a proportionate compromise, the Local Democracy Reporting Service said.

Five people spoke against the continued licence for three benches at the meeting on Monday.

They said the benches caused access issues, were "impacting negatively" on their trade and were only 1.47m (5ft) away from the road rather than the regulatory 2m (6ft 6ins).

The objectors added some customers parked prams outside which restricted access to a gallery and raised concerns about children running between the tables not being seen by passing cars.

They also said one table had been placed in front of a moveable bollard and restaurant customers had to get up and move from their table sometimes so a neighbouring business could gain access to load and unload.

Responding to the concerns, Fox said he wished to maintain positive relations with neighbouring businesses and none of the issues had not been raised directly with him.

He said during major sporting events, including the World Cup, he had personally attended the premises to deal with incidents involving intoxicated people and inappropriate language.

He added staff regularly sweep and clear the surrounding area and extra staff were been employed during the summer months to manage the outdoor seating area.

Fox said he already reduced the number from five benches to three and thought it provided sufficient space on either side of the seating area, but it would be acceptable to remove another table.

Following deliberations, committee members said they felt allowing two benches would be workable and allow the removable bollard to be freed up for vehicle access.

articles.title: Familiares, amigos y el mundo del fútbol dan el último adiós a Jesús de Miguel
articles.standfirst: Navahermosa ha despedido este jueves al futbolista del Tenerife fallecido el pasado martes
articles.summary: Navahermosa ha despedido este jueves al futbolista del Tenerife fallecido el pasado martes
articles.body: Navahermosa ha despedido este jueves a Jesús de Miguel, el futbolista del Tenerife fallecido el pasado martes. Su carrera deportiva lo llevó muy lejos de esta localidad toledana de poco más de 3.000 habitantes, de donde eran originarios sus padres y abuelos, y a la que regresaba siempre que podía. El Ayuntamiento decretó tres días de luto en pleno extraordinario y hoy, por última vez, las banderas ondean a media asta en señal de luto por una de sus vecinos más ilustres. El tanatorio del municipio se quedó pequeño para darle el último adiós a Demi. Desde primera hora de la mañana fueron llegando familiares, amigos y personalidades del mundo del fútbol para arropar a los suyos en tan duro momento. Por allí pasaron representantes de muchos clubes de Primera, como Miguel Ángel Gil (Atlético), Florentino Pérez y Emilio Butragueño (Real Madrid) y Pablo Blanco, embajador del Sevilla. La AFE estuvo representada por su presidente David Aganzo y la Real Federación Española de Fútbol, por Rafael Louzán, Aitor Karanka y el seleccionador Luis de la Fuente. Milagros Tolón, Ministra de Educación, Formación Profesional y Deportes, también acudió al funeral. "Hoy era el día de estar aquí, acompañando a la familia de Jesús. Nuestra solidaridad, es una pérdida irreparable. Esta tragedia nos debe indicar el camino que queda aún por corregir en relación a la prevención de los medios, para que estén siempre en el sitio oportuno. Es un día muy difícil. El fútbol debe estar unido hoy", aseguraba Louzán. "Reitero las palabras del presidente. Desde el dolor y el sentimiento, les trasladamos nuestro pesar y nuestro respeto. Es la mejor manera de demostrar que el fútbol está unido. Un abrazo muy fuerte a todos sus allegados", comentó, por su parte, De la Fuente. Unos de los momentos más emocionantes fue la llegada de la expedición de su club, el CD Tenerife, con todos sus compañeros de equipo. También estuvo presente el Castellón, su anterior equipo, con el que logró el ascenso a Segunda división. Decenas de coronas de flores de clubes de fútbol se agolpaban en la calle por falta de espacio. Muchas lágrimas. Mucho llanto. Muchas preguntas sin responder. Pasadas las 14:30 horas, el féretro emprendió el camino de la iglesia donde se ofició el funeral.

articles.title: 'Spanish' Villa por muchos años
articles.standfirst: Los dueños del equipo de Birmingham trasladan a Unai Emery y sus ejecutivos que quieren ampliar sus contratos que les unen al club hasta 2029
articles.summary: Los dueños del equipo de Birmingham trasladan a Unai Emery y sus ejecutivos que quieren ampliar sus contratos que les unen al club hasta 2029
articles.body: Reunión en Milán. Unai Emery, Damia Vidagany, Roberto Olabe y Nassef Sawiris, presidente y uno de los propietarios del club junto al americano Edens. Presente en marcha y futuro cerrado. La propiedad del Aston Villa no tiene dudas y quiere reforzar aún más la apuesta por el 'Spanish' Villa. Habrá más inversión, más recursos y los máximos accionistas quieren que al frente de los mismos, en la parcela deportiva, sigan estando Unai Emery y su equipo de ejecutivos españoles liderados por Damià Vidagany (director de operaciones deportivas) y Roberto Olabe (director deportivo de la entidad Premier). En la reunión, el egipcio trasladó al equipo deportivo encabezado por el entrenador vasco que el futuro está en sus manos y propuso una reunión más adelante para ampliar sus contratos con el Aston Villa que caducan en 2029. Pese al margen evidente en la relación contractual, con dos temporadas más por delante al dar un golpe de efecto en una temporada de reestructuración de la plantilla con la venta de siete 360 millones de euros y la apuesta por los mejores jóvenes de Europa. El mismo club aseguró en una publicación oficial que se trataba de una reunión de trabajo fundamental y tremendamente satisfactoria para las partes. Unai y su equipo se sienten queridos y respetados por un club que desde el minuto uno de su desembarco les ha dado las herramientas necesarias para cambiar la historia y devolverlo a lo más alto del fútbol europeo. “La reunión se centró en planificar la estrategia a largo plazo del club, con conversaciones positivas que van más allá de 2029...", aseguraba en Villa. El caso es que durante las últimas semanas el Manchester United había lanzado bastantes indirectos a Unai Emery. Le querían en su nuevo proyecto ya que ahora mismo no han dado con la tecla y acumulan fracasos deportivos temporada a temporada. La apuesta del Villa por 'los españoles' no tiene duda alguna y no ha variado con el interés de los diablos rojos. Emery se siente un villano más y considera que está en un club perfecto y con aspiraciones a todos en un futuro muy cercano. Hay 'Spanish' Villa para rato.

articles.title: La historia de Portugal A.C. y después D.C.
articles.standfirst: Desde la llegada de Cristiano a Portugal los lusos no se han perdido ninguna gran competición internacional.
articles.summary: Desde la llegada de Cristiano a Portugal los lusos no se han perdido ninguna gran competición internacional.
articles.body: El adiós de Cristiano Ronaldo a la selección portuguesa es el adiós de una leyenda. La despedida de un futbolista que llegó para cambiarlo todo y colocar a Portugal entre las selecciones más grandes del mundo. En cada uno de los partidos en los que ha defendido la camiseta de su país, Cristiano ha mostrado compromiso, liderazgo y calidad. Virtudes que lo han llevado a convertirse en el jugador del mundo con más partidos y más goles con su selección: 146 dianas en 234 encuentros. Cristiano Ronaldo debutó con Portugal el 20 de agosto de 2003, en un partido amistoso contra Kazajistán disputado en el Estadio Municipal de Chaves (Portugal). Entró al campo al descanso sustituyendo a Luis Figo y en un partido que su equipo ganó 1-0 con un gol de Simão. Tenía sólo 18 años y 6 meses y fue nombrado MVP del partido. La historia de la selección portuguesa hasta aquel día era bastante discreta. Su mayor éxito fue alcanzar las semifinales del Mundial en el año 1966, un éxito que resulta casi anecdótico, ya que los lusos sólo estuvieron en 3 Mundiales (1966, 1986 y 2022) en 69 años. Tres presencias de 18 posibles. Un saldo similar al de las Eurocopas. Hasta la llegada de Cristiano, Portugal había jugado tres (1984, 1996 y 2000), alcanzando las semifinales en dos de esas ediciones. La figura de Cristiano ha sido el eje sobre el que ha crecido su selección. Desde su llegada, Portugal no se ha perdido ningún gran torneo. Seis Mundiales y seis Eurocopas contemplan al luso. Números de récord que le han servido además para lograr su gran título: la Eurocopa de 2016. Además, a lo largo de este siglo de éxitos, la Portugal de Cristiano ha sido campeona de la Nations League en 2019 y 2025, subcampeona de la Eurocopa de 2004 y semifinalista en el Mundial de Alemania en 2006 y la Eurocopa de 2012. Títulos a nivel colectivo a los que Cristiano ha contribuido de forma directa con sus 146 goles con la camiseta de Portugal.

articles.title: "A Vinicius hay que recuperarle desde el banquillo y metiéndolo poco a poco"
articles.standfirst: 'El Corrillo' es el tiempo de Opinión de Directo MARCA
articles.summary: 'El Corrillo' es el tiempo de Opinión de Directo MARCA
articles.body: javier Tintó, Joan Prats, Alberto Pérez y Manu Martín debaten sobre la actualidad deportiva en 'El Corrillo' de Directo MARCA junto a Rafa Sahuquillo con la jornada de Champions como punto central del debate. La situación de Vinicius en el Real Madrid protagonizó uno de los debates más intensos del Tiempo de Opinión de Radio MARCA. El brasileño atraviesa un momento complicado y su rendimiento ha generado dudas sobre su continuidad como titular en el equipo de Mourinho. Javi Tintó defendió una solución contundente: "Vinicius se puede recuperar desde el banquillo, creo que de titular no". El tertuliano fue más allá al advertir que "si Vinicius no va a aceptar ser suplente cuando ve que el equipo juega mejor sin él que con él, Vinicius no puede ser jugador del Real Madrid". Una postura que encontró respaldo en Manu Martín, partidario de que el brasileño recupere la confianza entrando desde el banquillo. Sin embargo, Alberto Pérez y Joan Prats mostraron sus dudas sobre la capacidad del futbolista para aceptar un papel secundario. "Creo que su ego es absolutamente incapaz de aguantar una etapa continuada en el banquillo", señaló Alberto, mientras Joan apuntó que Vinicius "ha ido en decadencia tanto futbolística como también a nivel de actitud, confianza, y ha ido perdiendo terreno a nivel de club". El debate también dejó una reflexión sobre la convivencia entre las estrellas ofensivas del Madrid. "El problema de Vinicius, igual que el problema de Mbappé, es que se estorban entre ellos", apuntó uno de los participantes, en una discusión que puso sobre la mesa incluso la posibilidad de una venta como alternativa a una situación que amenaza con convertirse en un problema para Mourinho. La tertulia también abordó la petición de la AFE de suspender la jornada de Primera y Segunda División tras el fallecimiento de Jesús de Miguel. Manu Martín defendió que "no hay mejor homenaje que un partido de fútbol y no hay mejor homenaje que todo el fútbol unido en ese minuto de silencio", mientras otros participantes respaldaron que sean los propios futbolistas quienes decidan si están en condiciones de competir. Además, se planteó la necesidad de revisar los protocolos médicos en los estadios para evitar que se pierdan minutos decisivos ante una emergencia. En el plano deportivo, el Atlético-Barça del domingo centró las miradas: Joan Prats advirtió de las "lagunas en fundamentos defensivos individuales" del conjunto azulgrana, mientras Alberto Pérez pronosticó un encuentro igualado y aseguró que el Atlético «no va a perder».

articles.summary: El técnico del Sporting sigue acumulando bajas y ya solo cuenta con un delantero a su disposición
articles.body: Al Sporting de Gijón se le siguen acumulando problemas en la enfermería. El conjunto rojiblanco suma a Alejo Sarco a la lista de lesionados y no podrá contar con el delantero argentino en la visita del Valladolid a El Molinón por una pequeña rotura muscular. Un nuevo contratiempo para Nicolás Larcamón, que se queda sin alternativas en la delantera del Sporting. Sin ninguno de los dos pichichis rojiblancos. Alejo Sarco y Antonio Casas comparten la condición de máximo goleador del Sporting en la presente temporada, con tres goles cada uno en su cuenta personal. También comparten espacio en la enfermería, donde el cordobés se encuentra desde hace varias semanas y donde permanecerá hasta 2027. Menos grave es la lesión de la promesa argentina, si bien su baja desprende al Sporting de sus dos máximos goleadores. El Sporting se aferra a su arma más letal. Ante la plaga de bajas, el conjunto rojiblanco necesita recuperar la mejor versión de Juan Otero. El delantero colombiano solo ha anotado un gol en el primer cuarto de competición y ya es su inicio menos goleador desde su llegada a Gijón en 2022. Aún así, los antecedentes invitan al optimismo. El ’19’ se coronó como el máximo goleador en todas sus temporadas disputadas en el Sporting. Su despertar goleador solo es cuestión de tiempo. A la espera de Andrés Ferrari. El delantero uruguayo se fracturó el peroné el pasado 15 de marzo marcándole un gol al Castellón. Desde entonces, ocho meses de parón que están muy cerca de llegar a su fin. El atacante, cedido por el Sint-Truidense belga, ya se entrena junto al resto de sus compañeros y su regreso cada vez está más cerca de convertirse en una realidad. La recuperación de Andrés Ferrari será el mejor fichaje posible para un Larcamón que se está quedando sin alternativas en el ‘9’.

articles.title: Kane's Kompany pact! Striker salutes boss and opens up on bold decision to ditch Spurs comfort zone
articles.summary: Harry Kane opened up on his strong working relationship with Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany following his contract extension until 2029. The strike...
articles.body:
Harry Kane opened up on his strong working relationship with Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany following his contract extension until 2029. The striker also reflected on his choice to swap Premier League familiarity at Tottenham for a challenge in Germany.

Perfect alignment between star striker and manager

Harry Kane's decision to commit his long-term future to FC Bayern reflects a strong tactical and mental alignment with manager Vincent Kompany. Since Kompany took charge, Kane has maintained his elite scoring rate while serving as a key leader in the dressing room.

"He might have only found out this morning, I've not had any contact with him in the last few days! He never put pressure on me," Kane said.

Respect for Kompany's relentless driving mentality

Kane detailed how Kompany's coaching philosophy matches his own professional standards, regardless of a player's stature or experience. "We had an open chat about four weeks ago, but that was more general... I respect the coach a lot, the way he drives everyone," Kane explained.

"Regardless of whether they've got 500 games under their belt or is new to the game. That's also my mentality, so we suit each other well."

"I imagined challenging for the league, the cup and the Champions League every year... I've always believed in myself. Wherever I've played, I've scored goals," he added.

Leaving Premier League comfort zone proved correct

Reflecting on his departure from Tottenham Hotspur in 2023, Kane expressed zero regrets about leaving the English top flight to test himself abroad. "I spent a lot of time in the Premier League, I always watched them a lot. It's nice to have a change of scenery," Kane noted.

"And sometimes a change is also good mentally... When I'm older, I'll look back and say this was the right step, to get out of my comfort zone."

"The belief in yourself is an important factor. I feel as good as ever here. We'll be playing at the highest level in the next few years," the England captain affirmed.

With both manager and star forward aligned, Bayern look positioned to maintain a steady tactical foundation over the coming seasons.

Kompany will rely on Kane's work ethic to drive the team's pressing structure and attacking fluidity.

The pair now turn their full attention back to defending their domestic titles and challenging for European honors.

articles.title: Grealish unavailable again for Everton
articles.summary: Jack Grealish remains unavailable for Everton's Premier League clash with Coventry on Friday, manager David Moyes confirms.
articles.body:
Jack Grealish remains unavailable for Everton's Premier League clash with Coventry on Friday, manager David Moyes has confirmed.

The on-loan Manchester City midfielder, 31, missed the Toffees' two games against Newcastle in the Premier League and Carabao Cup over the past week following a "breach of club discipline".

After Monday's win at St James' Park, Moyes said Grealish still has a future at the club but did not know when he would return to the team.

Now, speaking on Thursday before his side host Coventry, Moyes said: "No, Jack is not available.

"I wouldn't give you the plan but we will be working with Jack again soon."

Moyes and Everton have remained guarded about the issue, which is understood to have arisen from an unauthorised absence from training.

The club said he remained absent on Monday because of a lack of fitness, although Moyes said he could not comment at the time.

Asked if the upcoming international break could give Everton the opportunity to resolve the issue, Moyes added: "We just need to wait and see how things go."

Grealish is trying to rebuild his career at Everton, having fallen out of favour at City despite costing the club £100m in 2021.

Grealish, who played a key role helping City win the 2022-23 Treble, will be out of contract at the end of the season.

He scored twice in 22 games for Everton last season during a loan spell which was cut short by injury.

The midfielder returned to the club for a second loan spell this season but had only made six appearances before falling out of favour.

articles.title: Sebastian Hoeneß discusses contrasting fortunes of Niclas Füllkrug and Deniz Undav ahead of Stuttgart-Bremen clash
articles.summary: VfB Stuttgart head coach Sebastian Hoeneß has offered his assessment of the contrasting fortunes of German strikers Deniz Undav and Niclas Füllkrug ahead of...
articles.body:
VfB Stuttgart head coach Sebastian Hoeneß has offered his assessment of the contrasting fortunes of German strikers Deniz Undav and Niclas Füllkrug ahead of Saturday's Bundesliga encounter with Werder Bremen. While Füllkrug has celebrated a return to the national team following an extraordinary start to the season , Stuttgart captain Undav continues to await his first Bundesliga goal of the 2026/27 campaign.

The two forwards enjoyed considerably different fortunes when Jürgen Klopp announced his 24-man Germany squad for the November international window on Thursday. Füllkrug, 33, earned his first call-up since September 2025 after scoring nine Bundesliga goals in eight appearances for Bremen. Undav, meanwhile, was once again omitted despite having scored 19 league goals for Stuttgart last season.

The 30-year-old has endured a difficult opening to the current campaign, struggling to reproduce the goalscoring form that established him among Germany's leading domestic attackers. His performances have nevertheless retained the confidence of his head coach, who believes the striker's contributions are being overlooked amid his lack of goals.

Hoeneß defends Undav amid continuing goal drought

Speaking at Thursday's pre-match press conference, Hoeneß acknowledged that Undav's principal problem remains his failure to find the back of the net.

"What isn't there are the goals," Hoeneß said at the press conference. "If you look at the match in Istanbul , he could easily have had another two or three assists. I think he's generally getting back into his rhythm."

The VfB coach emphasized that Undav's difficulties were representative of the team's wider problems in the final third. Stuttgart created several promising opportunities against Galatasaray but ultimately failed to capitalize, suffering another disappointing defeat despite periods of encouraging attacking play.

"It's the same with him as it is with us generally," Hoeneß explained. "That final bit is missing. In his case, it's the chances that other players aren't converting. That's obviously an issue for us."

Undav's underlying performances have nevertheless raised questions beyond his lack of goals. According to Opta statistics , the Stuttgart striker has won just 20 percent of his Bundesliga duels this season. Hoeneß, however, remains convinced that the 30-year-old is moving in the right direction.

Hoeneß welcomes Füllkrug's return to Germany setup

Füllkrug arrives in Stuttgart enjoying a markedly different period in his career. The veteran has rediscovered his goalscoring touch since returning to Werder Bremen following difficult spells with West Ham United and AC Milan. His nine Bundesliga goals have helped propel Daniel Thioune's side into fifth place, earning the striker another opportunity to represent Germany.

"It's a very positive occurrence for the Bundesliga," Hoeneß said of Füllkrug's recall at his Thursday pre-match press conference. "He's had a rough time. We always knew that he could do it. He's demonstrating once again that he's strong with both feet and his head."

The Stuttgart trainer also praised Bremen's collective development, describing the visitors as the team of the moment.

Bremen have collected 15 points from their opening eight Bundesliga fixtures, losing just once. Their recent 2-0 victory over Hoffenheim further demonstrated the consistency that has made them one of the early surprises of the campaign.

Stuttgart, meanwhile, have collected nine points and remain some distance behind their Saturday opponents. Hoeneß knows that his side will require an improved performance to overcome a Bremen team currently enjoying far greater consistency.

The meeting also offers an intriguing personal contrast between two experienced German internationals.

articles.title: Se aplaza también el Castellón-Eibar por la muerte de Jesús de Miguel
articles.standfirst: El club orellut, en el que jugó Demi antes de fichar por el Tenerife, lo pidió y las instituciones dieron el O.K.
articles.summary: El club orellut, en el que jugó Demi antes de fichar por el Tenerife, lo pidió y las instituciones dieron el O.K.
articles.body: Castellón-Eibar era el partido que abría la jornada 13 de Segunda, pero hoy, jueves, fue aplazado. El club orellut pidió a las instituciones no disputar dicho partido, ya que los excompañero de Jesús de Miguel no estaban en condiciones anímicas para jugar. En la tarde de este jueves recibieron el O.K. de LaLiga y, por supuesto, que el Eibar desde el primer minuto estuvo a disposición del Castellón y es que Demi jugó con los de Castalia antes de fichar por el Tenerife. El Castellón dio a conocer el aplazamiento en un comunicado en el cual se puede leer: "El encuentro entre el CD Castellón y la SD Eibar, correspondiente a la jornada 13 de LaLiga Hypermotion y previsto para el viernes 6 de noviembre a las 20:30 horas en el SkyFi Castalia, queda aplazado tras el fallecimiento de nuestro exjugador Jesús De Miguel. El club solicitó a LaLiga el aplazamiento del partido al considerar que no se daban las condiciones emocionales para disputarlo, tanto en el vestuario como en el conjunto de la familia albinegra. LaLiga ha atendido la petición, y la nueva fecha del encuentro se comunicará próximamente. El CD Castellón quiere agradecer de forma muy especial la actitud de la SD Eibar, que en todo momento se mostró comprensiva y facilitó el aplazamiento desde el primer contacto. Un gesto de sensibilidad y deportividad que dice mucho de la entidad armera y que el club valora profundamente. Se devolverá el importe de las entradas compradas para el partido. Las que se hayan comprado online y con tarjeta, se devolverá directamente. Las que se hayan comprado en taquilla comunicaremos próximamente las fechas para hacer la devolución de las compras en efectivo. Para las entradas de los visitantes, tendrán que ponerse en contacto con el SD Eibar. Cuando se comunique la nueva fecha, se volverá a abrir la venta de entradas online y en taquillas para el encuentro ante la SD Eibar".

articles.title: Matthias Jaissle says 'good to feel' club 'committed' to him
articles.summary: Newcastle United manager Matthias Jaissle says he has "got more of a feeling from within the club" about how "committed" they are to him amid his side's struggling form.
articles.body:
Newcastle United manager Matthias Jaissle says he has "got more of a feeling from within the club" about how "committed" they are to him amid his side's struggling form.

The Magpies were booed at the end of a 1-0 home defeat by Everton on Monday, a result that left them 13th in the top flight with 11 points from nine games.

It followed them being knocked out of the Carabao Cup by Everton in their previous game and left the Tyneside club with just two wins from the past seven matches, a run including defeats by Leeds United , Coventry City and Aston Villa .

"I try to not follow things that are written but here and there you get some comments," said 38-year-old Jaissle when asked about whether he has felt pressure on his position.

"The nice part is that I got more of a feeling from within the club about how committed they are and that is something really important in a week where there is speculation or rumours.

"It was good to know, good to feel but I try again in these aspects not to be distracted."

Jaissle, who took over from Eddie Howe at Newcastle United in the summer, said his players had not followed the "plan" in his post-match news conference after the defeat by Everton .

However, prior to his side's game at Fulham on Saturday (15:00 GMT), he believes the players are united and "really clear" about his ideas.

"Yes, for sure. That is always good to see. That is the fundamental thing in the process at the moment that we can count on is the unity and togetherness," he said.

"We have such a good group and such a good relationship already that again, the door is always open and if anything is unclear they are more than welcome to talk about it.

"When you see them in training and see how we are doing, I am pretty sure that everyone understands and are fully committed."

articles.title: The awkward ending to Cristiano Ronaldo’s extraordinary Portugal career
articles.summary: Despite a remarkable international career, the bitter context of Ronaldo’s goodbye still lingers.
articles.body: During the five minutes it took to watch Cristiano Ronaldo’s emotional farewell video to the Portuguese national team, it was easy to forget the sour note on which his international career has ended. For a player whose career has been defined by ruthless self-confidence and the endless pursuit of statistics, it was refreshing to see the 41-year-old speak with such humility and vulnerability about a 23-year love affair with the national team. “Over the years, I learned a few very simple things. Goals fade, trophies end up in museums, records are eventually broken,” he said. “But there is something that time can never erase: the place we hold in people’s hearts. “If I ever made you happy, if one of my goals ever made you embrace someone, forget a worry, or feel proud of our country, then it was all worth it.” It was, in isolation, a poignant note to wrap up his duty – an emotional monologue from the heart that spoke to his national pride and gratitude to all those who helped him along the way. But, after the video ended and the highlights of his remarkable career stopped playing, the bitter context of his goodbye still lingered faintly in the background. One final farewell? After all, just a month ago, Ronaldo had walked out on his country, embroiled in a public spat with the new head coach who seemed keen to usher in a new era without the veteran striker. Despite that, the superstar accepted his lenient punishment, and many probably expected him to be named in Portugal’s squad for the upcoming international fixtures against Wales and Denmark this month. But before the Portugal Football Federation (FPF) could announce which players had made that squad on Friday, Ronaldo announced his decision to step aside. The sequence and timing of those two things perhaps speaks volumes. Cynics will say that Ronaldo jumped before he was pushed – posing the possibility that the veteran star wasn’t going to be named to the upcoming roster. So, instead of facing that harsh reality, he decided to call it quits. If that assumption was true, it would likely be a tightly held secret for many years to come. So, in the wake of his announcement, the FPF quickly followed up with a short statement that glossed over any ill feelings in recent weeks. After all, this is a man who has done so much for soccer in the country. It should therefore come as no surprise that the FPF said it “refuses to let this farewell take place without due tribute.” It added: “It is our firm and immense desire to organize, plan, participate, and actively collaborate in what will always be a fitting tribute to Cristiano Ronaldo’s immense career, in which fans and the country can applaud and celebrate, once again, the player who has given us so much.” What exactly that tribute entails is unclear at this point. Ronaldo seemed definitive in his video that he would not be playing in a Portugal shirt again, seemingly ruling out one final dance for the national team. But, despite his reluctance to take a back seat even when Portugal looked better without him in recent years, his legacy is still one that deserves to be celebrated – much like how Lionel Messi said goodbye to Argentina last month. Unrivaled success It’s hard to believe there wouldn’t be one final celebration. After all, there was a world before Ronaldo made his debut for Portugal in 2003 and a very different world after it. For one, no man in history has made as many appearances (234) or scored as many goals (146) for their country. Ronaldo’s supreme talent also led his country to its first major silverware at the 2016 European Championships, and followed it up by helping the Seleção to victory in the 2019 and 2025 UEFA Nations League. There are simply too many iconic moments to mention – his hat-trick against Spain at the 2018 World Cup, the iconic wink to the camera during victory against England in the 2006 World Cup and the teenager’s tears after losing the Euro 2004 final to Greece all spring to mind. It’s no secret, though, that Ronaldo should have left a long time ago. His performances had dropped below an acceptable level in recent years and his body just couldn’t cope with the rigors of top-flight soccer anymore. If he had walked away a few seasons earlier, perhaps after the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, he would have almost certainly enjoyed a farewell to rival that of Messi – who was surrounded by an outpouring of love from thousands in his nation’s capital. But you sensed it was that same rivalry with Messi that forced him to continue for another four years. In 2022, the Argentine star lifted the World Cup trophy – an achievement many said settled the GOAT (greatest of all time) debate. Surely, for a man as competitive as CR7, that was motivation enough to try one more time this summer. But it wasn’t to be, and the World Cup in North America underlined that Ronaldo’s time on the international stage was up. It’s why the final chapter of his international career has felt more like the anguished completion of a prolonged divorce than a glorious send-off. Fans had already grown frustrated and the fallout with the head coach only underlined how imperfect an end it was to the most extraordinary international career. But when you strip it all away, you’re still left with a man who has done more for his country than most. Someone who has put more smiles on faces than you can imagine. And we can expect the records to keep tumbling. Ronaldo is still playing club soccer for Saudi side Al-Nassr FC, where he’s closing in on 1,000 career goals. Achieving that feat would be another fitting statistic to honor one of the greatest players in history, as he trudges ever closer to retirement from the sport he has helped to redefine.

articles.title: Miami's Darian Mensah Not Concerned With CFP Bracket Expansion, 'NFL is on My Mind'
articles.summary: The College Football Playoff bracket may be expanding, but Miami Hurricanes quarterback Darian Mensah doesn't plan to stick around for it.
articles.body:
The College Football Playoff bracket may be expanding, but Miami Hurricanes quarterback Darian Mensah doesn't plan to stick around for it.

During a recent interview with GQ's Alex Kirshner , Mensah was asked about his thoughts on the impending 24-team playoff bracket expansion.

"If everything goes to plan, it won't really concern me," Mensah said. "The NFL is on my mind."

Mensah is the prototypical modern college quarterback: He is a two-time transfer currently on his third team in three years. Despite switching teams each year, the 21-year-old has made steady improvements since his first season with Tulane in 2024, and he has hit his stride through Week 9 of the 2026 season.

Mensah has led the Hurricanes to the No. 1 rank in the nation with an undefeated 8-0 record, and he's currently the favorite to take home the Heisman Trophy. He has completed 188 of his 233 pass attempts for 2,425 passing yards with 25 passing touchdowns and six interceptions. His staggering 80.7 percent completion rate is best in the nation.

A significant portion of Mensah's success can be attributed to his connection with wide receiver Malachi Toney. Whether or not the Hurricanes quarterback sticks around for the playoff expansion could ultimately come down to how he performs without Toney, who is expected to undergo surgery after injuring his ankle in practice.

As things currently stand, Mensah is expected to be a top-10 pick in the 2027 NFL Draft. Oklahoma State's Drew Mestemaker is the only quarterback expected to be selected ahead of him, according to consensus rankings .

The College Football Playoff is expected to move toward a 24-team format starting in the 2027 season through an agreement with ESPN . Under the new proposal, the top eight seeds would receive a first-round bye followed by a home game, and the next eight seeds would host a first-round game.

articles.title: Jesus de Miguel funeral: Family, friends and Tenerife players gather to remember striker who died following on-field collision
articles.summary: Jesus de Miguel's funeral took place in the village of Navahermosa on Thursday; the Tenerife striker died after a collision; LaLiga confirmed ⁠that fixtures in the first and second divisions would go ahead, apart from games involving Tenerife, FC Andorra and Castellon vs Eibar
articles.body:
De Miguel was involved in a collision with FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono on Monday and was taken to intensive care, after which his death was announced on Tuesday.

The Tenerife squad, club staff and majority shareholder Rayco Garcia attended the funeral. Also in attendance were Spanish FA (RFEF) ​president Rafael Louzan, Spain coach Luis de la Fuente, Real Madrid president ‌Florentino Perez and Atletico Madrid chief executive Miguel Angel Gil Marin.

The funeral took place at the San Miguel Arcangel ​church after a procession.

"Feeling so much affection for Jesus ​and seeing the impact he had on so many people is something ⁠we will always carry with us," the family ⁠said in a statement read out by the player's agent Manuel Hernandez before the funeral.

"Jesus leaves a void that is impossible to fill, but also cherished memories for all of us ‌who were fortunate enough to share our lives with him. Thank you for loving him and for standing by us."

Spanish police have opened an investigation into De Miguel's death.

Meanwhile, FC Andorra goalkeeper Owono said he is going through the most difficult ‌days of his life in a statement released by his club on Wednesday.

"These are the most difficult days of my life," ‌Owono said. "I struggle to find the words, and I find it very hard to ​process what has happened. I know there will be many questions to address, and I will face whatever comes with the utmost respect.

"But right now, honestly, ​I cannot think about anything other than Jesus and the ⁠pain we are experiencing. Rest in ⁠peace, Jesus."

Tenerife's match against Granada and FC Andorra's game with Mallorca have been postponed this weekend.

Las Palmas, will play their against Eldense on Sunday in blue and white colours, traditionally ⁠worn by their main rivals Tenerife, as a tribute to De Miguel.

Meanwhile, Tenerife owner Garcia invited fans to ​Tenerife's stadium on Saturday to pay their respects to De Miguel ​in what he called "the last goodbye".

LaLiga have confirmed ⁠that fixtures in the top two tiers will go ahead, with a few exceptions. Those exceptions being FC Andorra vs Mallorca, Granada vs Tenerife and Castellon vs Eibar.

This is despite the Spanish Footballers' Association calling for the suspension of this weekend's round of matches on Thursday.

De Miguel spent two-and-a-half years at Castellon before moving to Tenerife in 2025, and LaLiga accepted ⁠the club's request to postpone their match.

A minute's silence ​will be observed before each game that goes ahead, while the referee will stop ​play at the first interruption after the ninth minute, in recognition of the number nine shirt De Miguel wore for Tenerife.

articles.title: Julian Sayin Injury Update, Ohio State HC Ryan Day Provides Latest Return Timeline for Star QB
articles.summary: Ohio State head coach Ryan Day provided an update on his radio show Thursday regarding quarterback Julian Sayin, who suffered an undisclosed injury to his right (throwing) arm on Oct. 17 in a 19-15 win at Indiana.
articles.body:
Ohio State head coach Ryan Day provided an update on his radio show Thursday regarding quarterback Julian Sayin, who suffered an undisclosed injury to his right (throwing) arm on Oct. 17 in a 19-15 win at Indiana.

"I'll kind of let him handle that, his family," Day said regarding Sayin's medical status, per Jonathan Wagner of On3. "All things considered, the outcome with the different options that were (available) kind of going into the situation thinking it could be, I think this has been a decent outcome for us and for him.

"We'll kind of let him go through that, but this thing looks to be healing. It's not gonna be next week or next month. It's gonna take some time, but I think certainly for the long term, we feel like we're on a good track here."

Sayin suffered the injury after Indiana defensive lineman Mario Landino sacked him and forced a fumble in the fourth quarter of Ohio State's victory. He left the game and later went back to the sideline with his arm in a sling.

Day's remarks indicate that Sayin won't return in the regular season, which features four more games from Nov. 7-28 vs. Oregon, Northwestern, Nebraska and then arch-rival Michigan.

It's a tough blow for the Buckeyes, as Sayin completed 68.2 percent of his passes for 2,007 yards (10.5 yards per attempt) and 19 touchdowns (four interceptions) in six games this season.

Looking ahead, the first round of the College Football Playoff is scheduled for Dec. 18-19. No. 12 Ohio State is currently the first team out .

True freshman Luke Fahey took over for Sayin against Indiana and started the team's 30-18 road loss to USC. He completed 21-of-38 passes for 260 yards and a touchdown.

Day has already confirmed Fahey will start Saturday at home against Oregon.

Redshirt freshman Tavien St. Clair is the team's backup.

articles.title: Premier League predictions: Chris Sutton v Football Manager, the game - & AI
articles.summary: BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on the computer game Football Manager 27, plus the BBC readers and AI, with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures.
articles.body:
AI is leading the way in BBC Sport's prediction league table, but this week Chris Sutton has more than one machine to worry about.

His guest opponent for this weekend's fixtures is a computer game: Football Manager 27, the latest edition of the long-running management simulation series, which is released on 10 November.

The FM27 game engine has played out this weekend's matches and you can see its results, including goalscorers, below.

Miles Jacobson, the studio director of Sports Interactive, the company behind Football Manager, also joined in.

Do you agree with their predictions? You can pick your own below.

The most popular scoreline selected for each game is used in the scoreboards and tables at the bottom of this page.

A correct result (picking a win, draw or defeat) is worth 10 points. The exact score earns 40 points.

Want to make more predictions? You can play BBC Sport's new Match of the Day predictor game every week, featuring six fixtures from domestic and European competition.

Among the new features in Football Manager 27 [FM27] is the expanded ability to tweak your manager's visual appearance, including an option that means wheelchair-using managers are represented in the game for the first time.

"It's something we are really proud of," Jacobson told BBC Sport. "Some might think it is only a small thing, but for wheelchair users it is an absolutely massive thing to be able to be represented in the game that they love.

"I am not a teary person, but I have to admit I had some tears in my eyes last weekend when I was watching some Instagram videos from our free trial of the game, of disabled people who just wanted to be seen, and represented.

"It seems really obvious to those of us who have been represented in games for years, but just giving people an opportunity to be represented, when they haven't been before, really does mean a lot to them. That has just been brilliant to see."

A more immersive world has been created for FM27, which includes a new training system called Tactical Effectiveness.

"It reflects what happens in real life when a new manager comes into a club and does something different - it takes players a while to get used to the new tactics," Jacobson said.

"So, when you are the manager coming into a club, you have to decide whether to spend more time training the players in a really complicated tactic - which is going to take them a long time to learn and which means less time training them on other things - or do you start off with the basics, and build from there?

"It's a little bit like what Nottingham Forest boss Oliver Glasner talked about after their performance in their defeat against Brentford last week, when he said he had been nice to his players, but now they have to listen and do what he is saying.

"I expect he is spending a lot of this week doing tactical effectiveness training in the background, or focusing on one part of it, because there are multiple elements."

Chris Sutton and Miles Jacobson were speaking to BBC Sport's Chris Bevan.

The AI predictions were generated using Microsoft Copilot Chat - we simply asked the tool to 'predict this weekend's Premier League scores'.

FM27's Premier League predictions, including goalscorers and red cards

Like all the promoted teams, Coventry are having a go in games.

It has worked too, because they have picked up a few wins so far - they have three in the Premier League, as many as sixth-place Brentford .

It has been a strange season for the Sky Blues so far, because their performances have been a bit up and down. They can look very open, but those wins are the reward for their brave approach.

I don't see them getting anything here, however, on Frank Lampard's return to his former club.

Everton are not a free-scoring side, but I think they will have a bit too much nous for Coventry .

Miles' prediction: Both of these teams are in good form and this is probably the game I wrestled the most with before deciding what to go for. Thierno Barry has been a revelation for Everton this season and they showed against Newcastle that they can win without Jack Grealish, while Jack Rudoni has started to shine for Coventry at just the right time.

It's going to be a cracker of a game but I've gone with Everton to win, firstly because their defence is so strong at the moment, and Coventry might find them harder to break down than they did Sunderland , but also because David Moyes' side are playing with a lot of confidence now. 2-1

Tottenham always seem to do well against Leeds - they have only lost one of their past 15 meetings in the Premier League, going back almost 25 years.

I am a little bit of a believer that some teams always do well, or badly, against certain opposition or on certain grounds.

I had the same as a player when I had bogey teams or stadiums, as well as lucky ones. For example, while I always used to score against Everton at Goodison Park, I always had a stinker at Highfield Road, Coventry 's old home, despite getting plenty of goals against them in home games for Blackburn.

So, I am definitely not going for Leeds to win this - but do I back Tottenham to win again and continue their good run?

Roberto de Zerbi's side have rocketed up the table on the back of three wins in a row, although they were helped out a lot by Jean-Philippe Mateta's red card in their victory over Crystal Palace last time out.

Tottenham are flying at the moment, and their confidence is up - we are seeing a bit of a Spurs swagger for the first time in a long while. So, while I don't think they will make it four wins in a row, I don't see them being beaten, either.

It's likely to be a very tight game. Leeds were a bit unlucky to lose to Bournemouth last week, but their lack of goals is becoming an issue.

Miles' prediction: Leeds had such a brilliant start to the season, while Spurs have turned the corner and they have got lots of players coming back to full fitness. I can't separate them. 1-1

Hull are scrapping for points and hanging on in there in a lot of games.

I get a lot of my predictions wrong for their games because I always go for them to lose, but I am not going to do anything different for them this week because of who they are playing.

Arsenal are just monsters, aren't they? They always seem to find a way and do enough to win games, even when they don't play well, and they will grind another result out here if they have to.

Miles' prediction: Hull have been so entertaining, and I just absolutely love watching them because they play with no fear whatsoever. At the start of the season you would have looked at this and thought Arsenal would hit them for four or five, but I think it will be much closer than that because you can never write off Ollie McBurnie.

I enjoy watching Arsenal too, by the way, in the same way that I enjoy watching chess. They are a beautiful team to watch tactically and it is just difficult for them when they attack at the moment because they have lost a lot of their width with Bukayo Saka out injured. They seem to be grinding out a lot of their results but I still enjoy watching them - I enjoy watching any team, for different reasons. One of the beautiful things about football is there is no one set way to play it.

Arsenal often go 1-0 up and shut up shop, but they will have to do a bit more than that here, because Hull will keep going at them. 2-1

What are Newcastle ? What type of team are they? I am not sure and that's why their manager, Matthias Jaissle, is getting a bit of stick from Magpies fans.

That's what is different with today's Premier League compared to my playing days, because we see it all the time now - even a new manager comes under pressure if they have a couple of bad results.

Newcastle have lost three of their past four league games and, in this day and age, that's enough for people to say the wheels are coming off.

That's why this game feels big for Jaissle. Win, and the Magpies head into the international break on a positive note. Lose it, however, and stand by for a lot of moaning and grumbling from their fans over the next couple of weeks.

That's what I think will happen, too. Fulham 's results have picked up and so have their performances. They are at home here, and I am expecting them to be too slick and too well organised for Newcastle .

Miles' prediction: Fulham are playing a completely different formation under Alvaro Arbeloa this season and they have taken a long time to build it up.

Newcastle are definitely a project under Matthias Jaissle, too. I've just taken Yoane Wissa out of my Fantasy team so I am not expecting him to start scoring this week - I think they need the international break to sort out some of their manager's ideas. 0-0

Nottingham Forest just cannot score - they have managed only six league goals in their first nine games, the lowest total in the Premier League.

Their manager, Oliver Glasner, got a bit stroppy after their defeat by Brentford last time out, saying he will make changes or he will end up being sacked. He tried the carrot approach at the start of the season but his team didn't bite - so now he is trying the stick.

We might see a reaction here, and I do think Forest will score - Manchester City goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma might even chuck one in for them, going off his recent poor form.

It certainly won't be easy for City and they have their own issues at the moment after back-to-back league defeats, but I am still expecting them to create enough chances to win.

Miles' prediction: Forest are another team who could do with the international break. Last season, Nikola Milenkovic and Murillo were two of the best centre-backs in the Premier League, but they look completely out of sorts at the moment. I can't see anything but a City win here. 0-3

I just can't see past Brighton here - they are superbly organised, carry a threat going forward and defend well. Their bench is strong as well.

Brentford are also going well and are capable of causing them a problem or two - but, after watching Brighton beat Manchester City at Etihad Stadium last week, I am backing Fabian Hurzeler's side here.

I always think the Bees have got a goal in them, so I am going to say they will score, but the Seagulls are smart enough to come out on top.

People seem to be unsure whether Brighton are really in the title race or not, but they are certainly in the mix for second place if Arsenal are the team we all think are going to win it.

Miles' prediction: What a revelation Brighton have been. They are just beautiful to watch and, again, they play with no fear. What they are doing on and off the pitch is just fantastic, but then you could say the same about Brentford . This will be a brilliant game and I wish I could watch it live. 2-2

Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage was not helped by Mateta's sending-off in their defeat by Tottenham and the Eagles striker will miss this game after they failed with their appeal to overturn the decision.

Whether you thought that was a red card or not, you feel for Sage because he is coming under a lot of pressure and a lot of Palace's problems are not his fault - he took charge at a difficult time.

Liverpool have issues too, and they come into this game off the back of a lousy performance and result against Fenerbahce on Wednesday.

Aston Villa hit the Turkish side for six a couple of weeks ago, but Liverpool struggled to keep them quiet and Palace might feel they can pick the Reds off in the same way.

Liverpool won't change the way they play under Andoni Iraola, so they will try to be aggressive with their press but are likely to be left open again if Palace get past it.

I don't see that happening this time, though, mostly because Palace have been so poor.

Liverpool were leaky against Fenerbahce, but I am going for them to keep a clean sheet here and get a sneaky away win, with Alexander Isak and Bradley Barcola getting their goals.

Miles' prediction: I have mates who work at Palace and I know they probably won't talk to me for a week after this prediction, but I am going with Liverpool here. Mateta's suspension is huge for the Eagles, and Ismaila Sarr is still out injured. 0-2

Bournemouth have turned into one of the Premier League's form teams.

I thought they would run out of steam against Leeds last week but I was wrong, and they have shown they have got a bit of depth in their squad.

I've been surprised by Ipswich too, and they were unlucky not to beat Hull last time out. The Tractor Boys have got a bit of spirit about them, which makes me think they will get something from this game.

Bournemouth are a front-foot team under Marco Rose, who is a very attack-minded manager, but Ipswich will have a go too. I can see them getting a point.

Miles' prediction: I have been really impressed by Ipswich in the past few weeks and Julio Enciso has been doing really well for them - but Bournemouth are absolutely flying. What a season they are having. 0-2

I keep hearing how Sunderland boss Regis le Bris is under pressure. Really? After finishing seventh and getting a promoted side into Europe last season, it seems crazy that his job is at risk now.

Still, Le Bris has plenty of problems to solve while his squad is being stretched by the Europa League - before this game they play Dinamo Zagreb on Thursday.

The Black Cats won this fixture on the final day of the last campaign, but their home record is nothing like as strong this time around.

They are also conceding an average of almost two goals a game in the Premier League, compared to 2025-26 when only three teams had a better defensive record.

Add that to their problems scoring - Forest are the only team with fewer goals so far - and you can see why they are bottom of the table.

I am still not sure how to judge Chelsea yet - yes, they beat Manchester United last week, but everyone beats Manchester United - but I just don't see the Black Cats keeping them out.

Miles' prediction: Sunderland are struggling with having European football and while I think they will turn things around, it won't be this week. Chelsea 's start to the new season has not been ideal and Joao Pedro being out injured is a huge loss to them - but I am still backing them here. 1-2

There were great scenes at Old Trafford on Tuesday with Manchester United coming back from 2-0 down to beat Roma, who had to field their third-choice goalkeeper because of injuries.

That ended up being a really good result, but there are so many things about United that are just not convincing at the moment - as a club they are trying to convey this picture of togetherness and it is just not there for me.

Beating Roma was a great comeback, of course, but you still feel United are not far from another collapse, especially against an Aston Villa team who are so well structured, and capable of punishing any weakness.

Villa boss Unai Emery has been talked about as a potential successor to Michael Carrick at Old Trafford, but he is too good for United as far as I can see.

United will score, but Villa are going to win this. Nicolas Jackson will bag a couple and we might see more tears from Bruno Fernandes at the final whistle.

Miles' prediction: I am probably going to get pelters from United fans from this, including some of my team members at Sports Interactive. One of them, who is a season-ticket holder, told me he wasn't going to this game, and therefore United will probably win... but I just can't see that happening.

I really feel for Michael Carrick because he did such a brilliant job last season and I hope he manages to turn things around, but Villa are looking really good at the moment. 1-2

Chris got four correct results, including two exact scores, from the 10 games in week nine, giving him a total of 100 points.

He beat his guest, Bad Day At The Office star John Hannah, who got four correct results with no exact scores, for a tally of 40 points.

And AI's four-week winning run is over, after it got five correct results and one exact score to end up on 80 points .

But the weekly win was claimed by the collective efforts of the BBC readers. They managed five correct results, including two exact scores, giving them 110 points.

There was only one game where everyone picked the right outcome - Chelsea 's 2-0 win over Manchester United .

Chris, John and AI all backed the Blues to win, just by the wrong score, but a lot of you got that part spot on too.

From more than 40,000 predictions by the BBC readers, that was the most popular scoreline selected, with almost 10,000 of you getting it exactly right.

articles.title: Lamine Yamal surpasses Kylian Mbappé to become Champions League’s highest-scoring teenager with 14 goals
articles.summary: Lamine Yamal surpasses Kylian Mbappé as the Champions League's highest-scoring teenager, achieving 14 goals after his performance in Barcelona's win over Aston Villa. Discover Yamal's incredible journey and record-breaking achievements in European football.
articles.body: Lamine Yamal has moved ahead of Kylian Mbappé in the Champions League record books, becoming the competition’s highest-scoring teenager after finding the net in Barcelona’s 3-0 victory over Aston Villa. The 19-year-old’s latest milestone came during a commanding performance by the LaLiga champions at Spotify Camp Nou, adding another record to a European career that began before he had even turned 17.Yamal moves past Mbappé with Barcelona goal against Aston VillaYamal opened the scoring in the seventh minute on Tuesday, November 3, capitalising on an Aston Villa mistake before bending the ball past goalkeeper Zion Suzuki. It was his 14th Champions League goal, taking him beyond Mbappé’s previous teenage record of 13.The Barcelona forward reached that total in 37 appearances in the competition, while Mbappé achieved his 13-goal teenage tally in exactly 23 appearances. Mbappé, who now plays for Real Madrid, has since gone on to score 72 Champions League goals in his career. The Frenchman had held the teenage record before Yamal surpassed it at Spotify Camp Nou.Barcelona went on to win 3-0, with Raphinha scoring twice after Yamal’s opener. The result ended Villa’s unbeaten start to the League Phase and provisionally lifted the Spanish champions into second place in the standings.A Champions League career already filled with recordsThe latest achievement adds to a series of age-related milestones Yamal has collected since making his European debut. He remains the youngest player to start a match in the Champions League proper, having made his first full appearance against Porto at just 16 years and 83 days.He is also the youngest player to score and assist in the same Champions League match, as well as the youngest to find the net in a semi-final. His scoring record is particularly notable for the number of goals he had accumulated before reaching successive birthdays: five before turning 18 and 11 before turning 19.Yamal is no longer the youngest player to appear in the competition's knockout stages, however, after Max Dowman took that distinction earlier this year. That record does not diminish the scale of his scoring achievements, which have now taken him beyond Mbappé's teenage total.Yamal's form gives Barcelona another attacking threatYamal's record-breaking goal is part of an impressive start to the 2026-27 campaign. Across 15 appearances in all competitions, he has scored 13 goals and provided 11 assists, giving Barcelona a consistent source of goals and creativity.His performances have also brought individual recognition. Yamal finished third in last week's Ballon d'Or voting, behind Bayern Munich forward Harry Kane and Mbappé, who placed second.At 19, he has already surpassed a Champions League scoring mark previously held by one of the competition's most prolific modern forwards. Mbappé's overall tally continues to grow at Real Madrid, but the teenage record now belongs to Yamal.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Crystal Palace 1-1 Hoffenheim: Daichi Kamada snatches late equaliser as 10-man Eagles ease pressure on Pierre Sage
articles.summary: Report as Daichi Kamada scores a stoppage-time equaliser to earn 10-man Crystal Palace a 1-1 draw with Hoffenheim in the Europa League; Adam Wharton's red card had threatened another defeat for under-pressure Pierre Sage after three successive Premier League losses
articles.body:
Palace arrived at Selhurst Park desperate for a response after three consecutive Premier League defeats had left them in the relegation zone, with growing questions over Sage's future as manager.

But their defensive vulnerabilities were exposed once again as Alexander Prass opened the scoring for Hoffenheim in the seventh minute, his effort squirming underneath Dean Henderson after the hosts were caught on the counter.

Sage's side showed some attacking promise but struggled to turn possession into clear-cut opportunities, while Hoffenheim looked dangerous whenever they broke forward.

Henderson was forced into an excellent save to deny Andrej Kramaric from close range, while Palace's evening took another turn for the worse when Wharton was shown a second yellow card in the 77th minute for catching Wouter Burger with his arm in an aerial challenge.

But just when it looked as though another damaging defeat was inevitable, Daichi Kamada rescued a point in stoppage time. Yeremy Pino delivered a cross into the area, Tyrick Mitchell nodded the ball down and Kamada finished through the goalkeeper's legs to spark relief around Selhurst Park and give Sage a precious moment of respite.

The draw leaves Palace with plenty to address, particularly defensively, but the manner of their late equaliser could prove significant for a manager whose position has come under increasing scrutiny. Sage will breathe easier, although this was hardly a performance to silence his critics ahead of Sunday's Premier League meeting with Liverpool, live on Sky Sports.

7: GOAL! Prass puts Hoffenheim ahead as Henderson lets his effort slip underneath him.

24: SAVE! Henderson produces a brilliant stop to deny Kramaric from close range.

67: CHANCE! Pino goes one on one but Oliver Baumann comes out on top.

77: RED CARD! Wharton is sent off after picking up a second yellow card.

90+1: GOAL! Kamada strikes late to rescue a point for 10-man Palace!

Sage hits back over Disasi omission after being questioned on losing control

Pierre Sage refused to explain why Axel Disasi was left out of Crystal Palace's matchday squad for the Europa League draw with Hoffenheim , insisting the decision was an internal matter before delivering a pointed response when challenged over whether it risked making him look like he was losing control.

The defender, on loan from Chelsea, was a surprise omission having previously played every minute of Palace's Europa League campaign this season and started their last two Premier League matches.

Disasi's absence raised eyebrows before kick-off, particularly after Palace initially named him in their starting XI on social media before correcting the teamsheet to show Honest Ahanor in his place.

Asked after the game why Disasi had been left out, Sage told reporters: "It's an internal decision. I don't want to comment."

The Palace manager was pressed on whether the situation was comparable to previous squad omissions involving other players, but remained unwilling to elaborate.

"It's nice to try to ask the same question, but I said I don't want to comment. Sorry for that because, you know, I always reply, but I don't want to comment on this thing," he said.

When it was put to Sage that leaving an important defender out of such a significant game without offering an explanation could give the impression he was "losing control", he replied: "That's your analysis."

articles.title: En Getafe no hay fiesta los jueves
articles.standfirst: Los de Bordalás quedan muy tocados, con un punto en tres jornadas de Conference
articles.summary: Los de Bordalás quedan muy tocados, con un punto en tres jornadas de Conference
articles.body: Al Getafe se le atraganta la Conference. Lo del Brighton no fue lo del Lugano, pero es la confirmación de que para competir en Europa le falta un paso. O dos. Los de Bordalás fueron claramente inferiores y en ningún momento dio la sensación, ni con el empate ni tras el gol inglés, de que los azulones podían competirle de tú a tú a un equipo que demostró su superioridad. El Brighton fue mejor desde el inicio. No mucho mejor, no apabullante, pero mejor. Como en un combate de boxeo cuando uno de los dos es mejor, que se nota pronto y lleva la iniciativa. Pues así. Los de Hürzeler se quedaron el balón, lo movieron mejor y lo llevaron más veces a zonas de peligro, aunque la primera gran ocasión la tuvo el Getafe a la media hora. Iván Azón bregó por un balón muerto en el segundo palo, remató a bocajarro y Verbruggen sacó una mano espectacular para evitar el gol azulón. Y del susto el Brighton, que había entrecerrado los ojos, se despertó. Hadjam atrapó un balón largo al que David Soria no salió, lo estrelló en el palo y en segunda jugada Boselli sacó bajo palos el remate de Yalcouyé. que ya celebraba el gol. 86 pases dio el Getafe en el primer tiempo, menos de dos por minuto, para acabar de definir esa primera parte. El Brighton también salió mejor al segundo asalto. Hadjam buscó la escuadra larga y lamió el larguero en el 52’, pero a los ingleses les costó diez minutos más encontrar el tesoro en la caja fuerte de Bordalás. Un centro largo lo devolvió Costinha al corazón del área para la entrada de Yalcouyé, que cabeceó un balón que tocó en el larguero antes de cruzar la línea de gol. Ni el gol ni la obligación hicieron mejor al Getafe, que siguió sin incomodar a Verbruggen mientras en el área de Soria el Brighton seguía rondando el segundo. Boselli se tiró con todo al suelo para despejar el remate de un Rutter que había dejado por los suelos a Djené y, al rato, Osman no se encontró el balón entre los pies para rematar un pase de la muerte que hubiera significado la sentencia del partido. Al Getafe se le complica la clase de matemáticas. Tiene que visitar Tiflis y al Ajax y recibir al Inter Club d’Escaldes andorrano en el Coliseum. Puntos quedan. La duda es si hay equipo para ganarlos. Lo que tenía que ser una temporada para salir de fiesta los jueves se está convirtiendo en un argumento para discutir todos los días.
